name.en: Micropile-supported fixed-tilt table (3P-7 kit, pile section not stated)
name.es: Mesa fija de tilt sobre micropilotes (kit 3P-7, sección del pilote no indicada)

description.en: Fixed-tilt ground table supported by two poles on micropiles (ProSolar 3P-7 micropile kit). The datasheet gives 21 modules per structure in portrait, three columns, tilt options and class 8.8 bolts. The micropile diameter, length, grout and steel section are not stated.
description.es: Mesa fija de tilt en suelo sobre dos postes apoyados en micropilotes (kit de micropilotes ProSolar 3P-7). La ficha indica 21 módulos por estructura en vertical, tres columnas, opciones de tilt y tornillería de clase 8.8. El diámetro, la longitud, la lechada y la sección del micropilote no se indican.

typical_use: Ground-mount tables on sites where ramming or driving is not feasible and a micropile foundation is specified.
applicable_standards: ISO 898-1 (reference for bolt class 8.8, not cited by the source)

materials.material: Steel, section and grade not stated

geometry.description: Two poles per structure (ProSolar). Pole spacing, micropile length and beam lengths are not stated; no lengths are modelled.
geometry.coordinate_system: x along module row, y up-slope/north-south horizontal, z up; origin at ground/roof contact of first support; mm and degrees

elements.note: Two micropile foundations per structure (ProSolar 3P-7). Length and diameter not stated; length_mm 0 is a placeholder.

reference_layout.note: 21 modules per structure in three columns (ProSolar 3P-7). Module dimensions are those listed on the same datasheet for its panel.

quantity.note: NOT SOURCED: placeholder, do not use

accessories.name: Micropile head cap or plate
accessories.purpose: Connects the superstructure to the micropile

grounding_bonding: Not stated in the source reviewed.
installation_notes: ProSolar 3P-7 datasheet lists tilt options of 10, 15, 20, 25 and 30 degrees (discrete options, not a continuous range).
unverified_items: Micropile diameter, length, grout and section (not stated)
Steel grades and bolt sizes, nut and washer standards, torques (not stated)
Pole spacing, beam and purlin lengths (not stated)
